task_spec: Add add_bid(price) so the book can record a newly observed bid.

bugs.description: add_bid appends to self.bids, but self.bids is maintained highest-first (sorted(bids, reverse=True) in __init__) and best_bid()/spread_to() rely on self.bids[0] being the maximum. Appending a bid higher than the current best leaves it at the end, so best_bid() returns a stale, too-low value. add_bid must insert in sorted position (or re-sort). Locally, appending to a list is unremarkable; the bug is only visible by connecting __init__'s ordering with best_bid's self.bids[0] assumption.
bugs.seed_note: HARD (non-local invariant): the sorted-descending invariant is never stated near add_bid; it is implicit in __init__ and best_bid.

provenance.note: freshly authored, calibrated to be hard to JUDGE (bug is locally plausible)
